description: This file defines a Kotlin class 'TaskRepositoryAndroidTestAdapter' which acts as an adapter for task repository in Android tests. It interacts with a fake local data store to perform CRUD operations on tasks, implementing the TaskRepository contract for testing purposes.

classes.name: TaskRepositoryAndroidTestAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class that uses a fake local data store to implement TaskRepository contract for Android testing.

methods.name: getTasks
methods.description: Retrieves all tasks from the fake data store.

methods.name: addTask
methods.description: Adds a new task to the data store and returns the updated list.

methods.name: updateTask
methods.description: Updates an existing task identified by ID and returns the updated list.

methods.name: deleteTask
methods.description: Deletes a task by ID and returns the remaining tasks.

methods.name: toggleComplete
methods.description: Toggles the completion status of a task by ID and returns the updated list.
